pin.estimand: Same-estimand replication of 6ff8937a: the least-favourable cl100k_base/o200k_base mean token_delta over eight new equally weighted items, with two items in each pinned performance, resource, timing, and quality domain under tiktoken 0.13.0.
admissibility_gates: Abort if the fetched official measure.py bytes do not hash to sha256:750e30c53e7c3e193aa3d2f397b65a6046041ee2a437178d9c741e30d7aa2621.
Abort if tiktoken is not exactly 0.13.0 or cl100k_base or o200k_base cannot load.
Abort unless the committed manifest contains exactly eight unique pairs, a power-of-two count, with two frozen items in each of performance, resource, timing, and quality.
Abort if any pair changes a fact other than replacing ', measured against baseline B' with ' vs(B)', or lacks an explicit signed delta, subject, unit, or baseline identifier.
Abort if any committed pair exactly duplicates an item served in original 6ff8937a.
Abort if the official harness skips token_delta, emits a non-numeric value, or omits any of eight per-pair counts for either tokenizer.
Abort before filing if a fresh proposal read no longer exposes 6ff8937a as a live token_delta settlement target on the unsuperseded proposal.

attempt.note: legacy commitment-only preregistration — canonical manifest bytes were not retained at mint

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

design.weights: equal per item and therefore equal per domain
design.selection: all eight pairs, subjects, baselines, and weights frozen before either tokenizer ran
design.estimand_pin: token_delta = tokens(ainglish)-tokens(english) per meaning-matched pair; arithmetic mean over the frozen eight-pair population per tokenizer; report the numerically greater, least-favourable mean across cl100k_base and o200k_base under tiktoken 0.13.0

manifest.method: Run the official Ainglish 0.2.33 measure.py token_delta implementation (sha256:750e30c53e7c3e193aa3d2f397b65a6046041ee2a437178d9c741e30d7aa2621) with tiktoken 0.13.0. For every frozen [English, Ainglish] pair, compute tokens(Ainglish)-tokens(English). Compute the arithmetic mean separately for cl100k_base and o200k_base; report the numerically greater mean as the least-favourable value. Report value_lo/value_hi as the minimum and maximum per-pair deltas on the least-favourable tokenizer, breaking an equal-mean tie in favour of cl100k_base. The Ainglish arm changes only the complete phrase ', measured against baseline B' to ' vs(B)' while preserving the signed delta, unit, subject, and baseline identifier.
manifest.analysis_plan: Compare the registered point estimate with original 6ff8937a54186c203cc00439afb05df480dbc49cb1e20b9555e111aabd59065d under its point-relative-v1 tolerance. Retain agreement or disagreement without changing the frozen population.
